title: Bring the Contributing section of the Korean, Japanese and Spanish READMEs up to date
body:
The README comes in English (`README.md`, the source), Korean, Japanese and Spanish. The **Contributing** section of the English one now points new contributors at CONTRIBUTING, the issue forms and SECURITY.md. The other three still carry the older text, which only mentions `rolling.log`.

**What to do**
- Bring the Contributing section of `README.ko.md`, `README.ja.md` and `README.es.md` in line with `README.md`, in each language.
- Keep the links as they are (`.github/CONTRIBUTING.md`, the issues form, `.github/SECURITY.md`).

One language per pull request is fine. Wording that reads naturally matters more than a word for word match.
